_note: All values sourced from uscis.gov. Any value that could not be confirmed from an official uscis.gov source is set to null with needsVerification: true. No values are guessed. Category weights are not included.

2008._description: 2008 Civics Test. Applies to Form N-400 filed before October 20, 2025.

earlyStopOnCorrect._note: Mentioned on the 'Study for the Test' page (uscis.gov) as stopping when 6 are answered correctly, but the primary civics Q&A page states 'up to 10 questions'. Verify against USCIS policy manual before relying on this for scoring logic.

earlyStopOnIncorrect._note: Mentioned on the 'Study for the Test' page (uscis.gov) as failing if 5 of 10 answered incorrectly, but the primary civics Q&A page states 'up to 10 questions'. Verify against USCIS policy manual before relying on this for scoring logic.

2025._description: 2025 Civics Test. Applies to Form N-400 filed on or after October 20, 2025.

earlyStopOnCorrect._note: USCIS officers stop asking when the applicant answers 12 questions correctly.

earlyStopOnIncorrect._note: USCIS officers stop asking when the applicant answers 9 questions incorrectly.
